item.title: Rsync backup remote server to local
item.description:
What can I say, a simple way to backup remote server on the local machine

rsync -aHxv root@remote.example.com:/* /local/backup/server/ \
		--exclude=/dev \
		--exclude=/proc \
		--exclude=/sys \
		--exclude=/tmp
